summary.intent: Execute Phase 26 (Observability & UX Tuning) of the cipher-box project, including Grafana alert rules and client timeout/retry tuning, then clean up the code and get a PR merged.
summary.outcome: Phase 26 was planned and executed successfully (2/2 plans, 14/14 must-haves verified). A PR was opened, CI failures were fixed, and Grafana free-tier cardinality limits were addressed by filtering Kubo/Someguy metrics and capping HTTP route label cardinality.

repo: GSD tools must be run from the correct working directory (cipher-box-ci-debug, not cipher-box) — running from wrong dir causes phase directory not found errors
Phase 26 branch (feat/phase-26-observability-ux-tuning) was created from main before PRs #360, #361, #363 landed, causing apparent 'unrelated removals' in diff that were actually main advancing
Grafana Cloud Free tier has a 10,000 active series limit — Kubo and Someguy nodes were the primary culprits exporting thousands of unused metrics
Dashboard only uses 6 external metrics from Kubo/Someguy: go_goroutines, go_memstats_alloc_bytes, libp2p_swarm_connections_opened/closed_total, libp2p_network_in/out_bytes_total
Alerts only reference cipherbox_* metrics — Kubo/Someguy scrapes had zero alert coverage
After merge conflict resolution on planning docs, Phase 24 and 25 completion marks were lost from ROADMAP.md and needed manual restoration
PR #365 branch (fix/recovery-e2e-kubo-ipns) is checked out in a separate worktree at /Users/michael/Code/cipher-box

code.finding: Added prometheus.relabel filter stage for Kubo and Someguy scrapes to only forward the 6 metrics actually used in dashboards, dropping thousands of unused series

Removed normalizeRoute method; unmatched routes (bot scanners, /.env, /wp-admin) now collapse to '/:unmatched' to cap HTTP histogram cardinality. Matched routes already use NestJS parameterized templates.
Tests hardcoded old baseDelayMs of 1000 — after tuning to 500, assertions needed updating: 1000→500 (first delay) and 2000→1000 (second backoff). 3 assertions total across 3 tests.
Timeout comments referenced ephemeral benchmark data ('~44x client-side pin p99 of 227ms') — removed in cleanup; comments should describe intent not one-time measurements

Two separate sed calls consolidated into one with -e flags; delimiter changed from / to | to avoid breakage if UIDs contain slashes. Also fixed --dry-run flag parsing to only scan ${@:4} (args after 3 positional params).

workflow: When merging a long-lived feature branch into main, planning doc conflicts (ROADMAP.md, STATE.md) require careful manual verification that prior phase completion marks survive the resolution
GSD tool 'carry forward: uncommitted session files' commits can pollute the branch with pre-existing changes that are unrelated to the current phase
Grafana metric cardinality should be audited before shipping any scrape configuration — filter at the Alloy/agent layer rather than at the source
CI test failures from timeout/constant tuning are easy to miss if tests hardcode expected values rather than reading from the source constant

friction: GSD execute-phase initially failed with 'no plans found' because plans hadn't been created yet — required a detour through plan-phase first
GSD tools running against wrong working directory (cipher-box vs cipher-box-ci-debug) caused confusing initialization failures
Merge conflict resolution on planning docs silently dropped Phase 24 and 25 completion marks — not caught until CodeRabbit flagged it in PR review
PR #365 branch was in a separate worktree, blocking inline fix of the review comment there
CI caught 3 test failures in delegated-routing.client.spec.ts after timeout tuning — hardcoded expected values in tests not updated alongside the constants
open_items: PR #365 review comment (fix/recovery-e2e-kubo-ipns worktree) was interrupted and not resolved
7 unresolved CodeRabbit review threads on PR #366 for planning doc inconsistencies — fix was committed but thread replies/resolutions were cut off
Alert JSON (~877 lines) has high structural duplication across 5 files — a config table + template approach would cut this significantly but was deferred
5s delegated routing timeout (tuned from 10s) flagged as potentially aggressive under load for delegated-ipfs.dev DHT-backed service — worth monitoring post-deploy
ipHash: '' empty string fails strict 64-char hex validation — bug noted but outside Phase 26 scope
